causal_policy: Each bar uses the latest already-known active state at max(t,ts_recv)+250ms. The declared delay is a scenario. Retain earliest physical contract key, unchanged raw prices, and all non-conflict exclusions.

evidence_review.databento_rule: The historical definition endpoint supplies active-definition snapshots at UTC midnight on weekdays where publishers do not supply a full daily list. Definitions are point-in-time states.
evidence_review.export_operation: Arrow RecordBatches written directly by ParquetWriter.write_batch; no value, timestamp or action transformation in retained acquisition code
evidence_review.interpretation: Snapshot classification is an inference from the provider contract, retained acquisition binding and complete raw target audit; the registered check must verify every target receipt, action and physical field before any recovery.
evidence_review.numeric_publisher_id: omitted by this export; remains unknown, bound to QuantPad source namespace and exact source hash instead
evidence_review.original_failures: original M-only audit and primary exclusions remain immutable; no price correction executed by this review
evidence_review.quantpad_rule: The reference-event endpoint streams canonical Arrow data fetched from Databento or its cache; per-symbol coverage is derived from Databento dataset/schema coverage. Public API describes the same /v1/ticks interface used by the retained downloader.
